scenario: The wind howls through Nanur Bari, carrying faint whispers that sound almost like your name.
You find an old, dusty diary under your bed. It seems to belong to your great-grandfather, full of ramblings about a 'guardian of the pond.'

outcomes.text: The last page describes a hidden lantern that reveals unseen things. You find it tucked away in the closet.
The pages are stuck together with some weird goo. You get it all over your hands and drop everything you're holding.
It's mostly boring farm stuff, but one page just says 'IT SEES YOU' over and over.
Probably for the best. Some secrets should stay buried.

scenario: Oli suggests flying his new drone over the creepy jungle at midnight to see what's making those sounds.

outcomes.text: The drone captures a blurry image of something massive moving between the trees. A paranormal magazine pays you for the pic.
A huge bird attacks the drone mid-flight, causing it to crash and get lost in the jungle forever.
The drone's camera feed shows a pale face looking right at it, then the feed cuts out. An hour later, something scratches at your door.
You all decide to watch a movie instead. It's probably safer.

scenario: Fakhruddin swears he saw a shadowy figure with no hands watching you from the edge of the pond.
You find a loose floorboard in the bedroom. Prying it open reveals a small, locked metal box.

outcomes.text: The box releases a cloud of black dust. You inhale it and collapse, your adventure is over.
Inside is a silver ring that feels unnaturally cold to the touch.
You use a rock to smash it, but it slips and breaks your phone screen instead. The box remains locked.
You slide the floorboard back. Whatever is in there can stay in there.

scenario: Mamanir cooking smells divine, but tonight the fish curry has a strange, earthy taste, almost like dirt.

outcomes.text: It tastes weird, but you feel surprisingly invigorated, like you just cheated death.
You convince yourself it's just a new spice. You feel fine... for now.
The cat takes one sniff, hisses at you, and claws up your backpack before running away.

scenario: The old swing in the garden starts moving on its own, creaking rhythmically in the dead air.
While walking near the graveyard, you find a small, crudely carved wooden doll that looks vaguely like Fakhruddin.

outcomes.text: You pocket the doll. Fakhruddin immediately complains about a sharp pain in his back.
The doll feels hot in your hand and you drop it, along with your wallet which rolls into a ditch.
You dig a small hole and put it back. You feel a sense of relief.

scenario: A sudden power cut plunges the entire house into darkness. Oli nervously jokes that the Jin is here.

outcomes.text: You find an old lantern. When you light it, the flame burns a sickly green, revealing strange symbols on the walls.
You find some matches and a candle. The flickering light makes everything look ten times creepier.
You hear footsteps approaching. It's not one of your friends.
You stumble around in the dark and knock over a vase. Mamani is not going to be happy.

scenario: You wake up to the sound of frantic scratching from inside your closet.
You dare Oli to swim to the middle of the pond at night. He agrees, but only if you go with him.

outcomes.text: You both swim out and make it back, hearts pounding. You feel like you could survive anything now.
You slip on the muddy bank on your way in, and your phone falls into the water. It's gone forever.
You both jump in, scream at how cold the water is, and immediately get out.
Fakhruddin calls you a chicken, but you're a dry, safe chicken.

scenario: The water in the pond turns murky and black for a moment, and you see something large and pale flash beneath the surface.
Moin finds an old map tucked into a crack in the wall. It seems to show a hidden room somewhere in Nanur Bari.
A mysterious old man from the jungle appears at the edge of the property, silently staring at you. He holds out a gnarled, root-like hand.

outcomes.text: He grabs your arm. His touch is like ice and fire. You don't come back.
He presses a weirdly shaped stone into your palm and vanishes back into the trees.
He points a finger at you, and you suddenly feel your pockets become lighter. He smiles a toothless grin.
You slam the door and lock it. Wise choice.

scenario: Fakhruddin suggests setting up one of the wildlife cameras inside the house to catch any ghostly activity.

outcomes.text: The camera captures an image of a tall, distorted shadow standing in the hall when no one was there.
The camera only shows footage of you all walking back and forth to the kitchen.
In the morning, the camera is gone, and so are you.
The camera footage shows a small, goblin-like creature stealing your stuff while you sleep.

scenario: A chilling whisper echoes from the well in the backyard, begging for help.
You decide to play a prank on Fakhruddin by hiding in the pantry and jumping out while he's getting a snack.

outcomes.text: He screams like a goat and throws a bag of rice at you. It's hilarious.
He's so startled he drops a jar of pickles. You spend the next hour cleaning it up and he steals your snacks as payment.
He doesn't even notice you and leaves. Your prank is a total failure.

scenario: The local market is eerily quiet. The tea-stall owner warns you not to go into the jungle after dusk, speaking of a thing that 'walks without hands.'
While fishing, you reel in a human skull instead of a fish. Its eye sockets seem to glow faintly with a green light.
Oli's drone footage reveals a strange symbol carved into the earth in the deepest part of the jungle, right where the blood was.

outcomes.text: You find a pouch of old coins buried under the symbol. Score!
It's a trap. The ground gives way beneath you.
You find the spot, but the symbol is gone, as if it was never there.
You delete it, but the spooky image is now burned into your phone's screen permanently, draining the battery.

scenario: You hear the sound of a woman crying softly coming from the direction of the old graves.
You find a single, perfectly preserved, ancient-looking coin on the doorstep, decorated with a skull.
Moin trips over a tree root and finds a silver locket half-buried in the dirt.

outcomes.text: It's empty inside, but it smells faintly of jasmine and decay.
A cloud of stinging dust flies out. In your confusion, you drop your bag and it rolls away.
You brush the dirt off your pants and keep walking.

scenario: An old radio in the living room crackles to life on its own, playing a distorted, sad tune from decades ago.

outcomes.text: The song is strangely hypnotic. You feel a sudden urge to record it.
The music fades out after a minute, leaving only static.
The moment you touch the plug, you get a massive electric shock. The radio keeps playing.

scenario: The reflection you see in the pond isn't your own. It's older, paler, and smiling cruelly at you.
Fakhruddin finds a strange, glowing mushroom growing on the side of a tomb.

outcomes.result: Adventure Ends & lose all your items
outcomes.text: Your vision blurs, and you feel your body dissolving. Bad choice.
You feel a jolt of energy surge through you. You feel like you could run a marathon.
It smells like damp earth and ozone.
It smells like damp earth and ozone.

scenario: Oli wants to try communicating with the spirits using a smartphone app that detects paranormal voices.

outcomes.text: A voice comes through the phone, screaming your full name. The phone explodes in your hand.
The app records a voice whispering winning lottery numbers. You try them and they actually work!
All you get is static and Oli complaining that he wasted money on the app.
Probably a good call. Those apps are scams anyway.

scenario: You notice all the clocks in the house have stopped at exactly 3:13 AM.
You find a half-eaten piece of a pitha in the jungle, right next to a patch of strangely disturbed soil.

outcomes.text: It's a box full of angry red ants. They swarm you and you drop everything while running away.
You unearth a small, tarnished silver ring with a skull emblem.
It was probably just some animal's snack.

scenario: The old groundskeeper, Foysal, warns you that the jungle 'demands a sacrifice' every few years to keep the spirits calm.
The air grows cold, and you can see your breath. It's the middle of a hot summer night.
A trail of bloody footprints leads from the jungle towards the house, but stops abruptly at the back door.

options.action: Follow them back into the jungle

outcomes.text: You follow the trail until it leads you right to the handless old man. He was waiting.
You get hopelessly lost and have to ditch your heavy bag to find your way back.
You find a couple of old padlocks and secure the door. You feel a little safer.
You lock the door and spend the rest of the night nervously peeking out the window.

scenario: You find the old man’s tattered shawl snagged on a bush near the graveyard. It feels unnaturally cold.

outcomes.text: As you pick it up, you feel a deep sorrow wash over you. The feeling doesn't leave.
You get tangled in the thorny bush trying to free it and tear your clothes and bag.
You carefully back away from the creepy shawl.

scenario: All the photos in the family album on the coffee table now have their eyes scratched out.
The door to the attic, which is always nailed shut, is slightly ajar. You can hear a soft humming from within.

outcomes.text: You find an antique compass that always points to the nearest source of danger.
The door slams shut behind you, and the humming stops.
You trip on the top step and tumble all the way down, scattering your belongings.
You find a hammer and some nails and secure the door. Out of sight, out of mind.

scenario: You dream of a hidden treasure buried under the ancient banyan tree, but a voice warns you that it's protected by a powerful Jin.

options.action: Dig for it in the morning

outcomes.text: You find a pot of gold coins! The Jin must have been on vacation.

outcomes.result: Adventure Ends & lose all your items
outcomes.text: The Jin was not, in fact, on vacation.
You decide not to risk becoming a ghost story.

scenario: You see a headless creature feasting on a dead fox. Its neck stump gurgles as it eats.
Oli's phone starts glitching, showing distorted images of what looks like the inside of a coffin.

outcomes.text: The phone explodes in a flash of green light. You should have just turned it off.
You chuck it into the pond. A moment later, all your other electronics start fizzing and die.
The phone works again, but now its background is permanently a picture from inside the coffin.
It reboots and works fine. Must have been a weird bug.

scenario: The food left out overnight is covered in thick cobwebs by morning, even though it was in a sealed container.
The trees in the jungle seem to rearrange themselves when you're not looking, making it impossible to find your way back.
A headless chicken runs frantically around the yard before collapsing in a heap.

outcomes.text: You pluck a feather as a souvenir. It seems to whisper insults when you're alone.
Dinner is served. Tastes like... chicken.
You decide you're not hungry enough to deal with possessed poultry.

scenario: You find a note written in what looks like blood on your pillow. It says, 'He watches you from the water.'
A mysterious fog rolls in, blanketing Nanur Bari. It's thick, and you can hear things slithering within it.

outcomes.text: You lock the doors and wait for it to pass. It's a very boring evening.
You walk into the fog and are never seen again.
You stumble upon a lost visitor who gives you a huge reward for guiding them back.
You get completely lost and drop your bag somewhere in the mist.

scenario: An old man appears before you, his hands restored but twisted into claws. He opens his mouth and a swarm of locusts flies out.
Fakhruddin starts speaking in a strange, deep voice, reciting some ancient curse in a language none of you understand.

outcomes.text: He snaps out of it, looking confused. 'Why did you slap me, choraaaa?'
He snarls and shoves you, causing you to drop your things. He doesn't remember doing it afterward.
You manage to record the creepy monologue. It might be useful later.

scenario: The Jin corners you in the old graveyard during a thunderstorm.

options.action: Use the collected items against it

outcomes.text: Your weird collection of cursed items somehow combines to banish the Jin in a flash of neon light, leaving behind a box.

outcomes.result: Adventure Ends & lose all your items
outcomes.text: The Jin laughs, says your junk is useless, and promptly ends your adventure.
Turns out, ancient evil spirits aren't really into peace talks.
